label: GOAL_013_1_R8_SOURCE_MECHANISM

auditScope.applicationReferences: Pinned to baseline commit bytes; candidate edits by other agents are outside this source audit. Installed dependency files were read and hashed locally.

userEvidence.origin: User-pasted FIRST_FAILURE from an existing iPhone preview/release-js build; not generated by this audit.

acceptance.note: Source inspection and software GLES reproduction support the candidate mechanism but do not establish a successful iPhone frame or release acceptance.

H1.claim: A first logical-default transition can submit BACK from Three onto the nonzero native default framebuffer used by Expo iOS, producing GL_INVALID_OPERATION even while framebuffer completeness remains FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE.
H1.cacheQualification: Three caches default draw buffers; do not claim one BACK call per frame or per every target restoration. Cache initialization/reset and changed binding determine whether it is emitted.
H1.deviceQualification: r7 catches a sticky error after rendering and before presentation. No per-command device trace or actual failed call is available; other native GL errors cannot be excluded merely from the shared 0x502 value.

existingCorrectionAudit.installedExpoJs: GLView context accessor and optional GLUtils logging do not translate BACK. The C++ host method installer forwards directly to audited bind/draw methods.
existingCorrectionAudit.installedExpoNative: bindFramebuffer remaps logical zero to defaultFramebuffer; drawBuffers forwards its vector unchanged. No compensating BACK translation exists in these installed methods.
existingCorrectionAudit.application: Baseline canvas observer only intercepts getContext temporarily; no GL method or enum patch.
existingCorrectionAudit.r3fNative: Bounded search of installed @react-three/fiber/native JavaScript and TypeScript found no drawBuffers/readBuffer/bindFramebuffer/BACK translation.

enums.inference: The observed type/format and application target defaults describe an unsigned-byte RGBA target, not a floating-point target. Completeness alone still does not prove legal draw-buffer selection.

readBufferScope.invocationEvidence: Three WebGLRenderer only invokes readBuffer in synchronous/asynchronous MRT pixel readback, with COLOR_ATTACHMENT0+textureIndex. No baseline application readback/readBuffer call and no readBuffer call in the audited iOS blit.
readBufferScope.decision: No readBuffer compatibility change justified for this failing mirror/main path. Keep independent READ_FRAMEBUFFER binding semantics if tracking draw bindings.

candidateBoundaryRequirements.suggestedScope: Owned Expo iOS GL context and logical default draw framebuffer only.
candidateBoundaryRequirements.trackBindings: FRAMEBUFFER updates both bindings; DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER updates draw; READ_FRAMEBUFFER must not change draw target tracking.
preserve: Restoration/removal at owner disposal or retry
avoid: Readback or software rendering claimed as iPhone acceptance

localSources.observation: setRenderTarget starts with framebuffer=null; absent renderTarget retains null; state.bindFramebuffer(FRAMEBUFFER,framebuffer) triggers state.drawBuffers when binding changes.
defaultDrawbuffers starts as an empty array; reset() also clears this cache at line 1281.
Render targets use COLOR_ATTACHMENT0+i. Logical default uses BACK. drawBuffers only forwards on a cache update; this is not evidence that every default restoration emits another BACK call.
getGl returns the installed global Expo context after configuring optional logging; there is no framebuffer or enum translation in this accessor.
Logging defaults disabled. When enabled the logger calls originalValue.apply(gl,args) unchanged. GET_ERRORS logging would destructively read errors; it was not enabled by this audit.
Native methods are installed directly on WebGL/WebGL2 prototypes.
A null argument is not an object carrying id and unpacks to EXGLObjectId zero; no private native FBO ID was queried in this audit.

bindFramebuffer queues glBindFramebuffer(target, framebuffer==0 ? ctx->defaultFramebuffer : ctx->lookupObject(framebuffer)). checkFramebufferStatus independently invokes the native completeness check.
drawBuffers converts the input JS array to a GLenum vector and queues glDrawBuffers without BACK translation.
readBuffer is SIMPLE_NATIVE_METHOD(readBuffer,glReadBuffer), with no mode translation.
Native methods obtain contextId from the original this object; simple methods queue generated native calls. Any compatibility adapter must preserve this binding and exception behavior.

iOS creates nonzero viewFramebuffer and msaaFramebuffer objects, attaches COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, and assigns msaaFramebuffer as the Expo default framebuffer. The logical default is not necessarily GLES FBO zero.
glContextGetDefaultFramebuffer returns msaaFramebuffer.
EXGLContextSetDefaultFramebuffer stores the supplied native framebuffer name on that context.
Context preparation derives supportsWebGL2 from native GLES version and binds/checks defaultFramebuffer.
Native presentation binds msaaFramebuffer as READ_FRAMEBUFFER and viewFramebuffer as DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER for blit. It does not invoke readBuffer(BACK). r7 failed before presentation was entered.
getError drains the actual native GL error through a blocking queued call.
UnsignedByteType=1009.
RGBAFormat=1023.
Texture defaults format to RGBAFormat and type to UnsignedByteType.
RenderTarget documents and applies default texture options, samples=0 and count=1; supplied mirror options do not override type or format.
UnsignedByteType maps to gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE; RGBAFormat maps to gl.RGBA.
For gl.RGBA, unsigned-byte data selects RGBA8 or SRGB8_ALPHA8 by transfer; float types select different formats. This source does not classify enum 1009 as float.
Mirror uses 384 by default, samples=0, depth=true, stencil=false, linear filters and no mipmaps; no explicit type or format override.
The application saves the active target, renders its reflection target, and restores previousTarget in finally. With the main target active, this restoration is setRenderTarget(null).
The baseline adapter temporarily observes canvas.getContext and restores it; it does not patch GL methods or enums.

The baseline session samples GL diagnostics after main render returns and before the native presentation wrapper proceeds. A nonzero GL error stops the lifecycle. This observes accumulated errors, not individual command causation.
The baseline observer samples status/version and drains at most four native errors; getError is destructive. No second observer or new GL query was added by this audit.
readBuffer occurs only in MRT readRenderTargetPixels, using COLOR_ATTACHMENT0+textureIndex; this is not used by the mirror/main path.
The other renderer readBuffer call is asynchronous MRT pixel readback, again COLOR_ATTACHMENT0+textureIndex.

primaryReferences.support: For a bound framebuffer object, each draw-buffer entry must be NONE or its matching COLOR_ATTACHMENT index; BACK is invalid there. Default-framebuffer restrictions differ.
primaryReferences.use: Normative API mechanism; not proof of a particular device call.

primaryReferences.support: Errors remain until getError reads and clears them; multiple flags may require repeated reads. INVALID_OPERATION does not itself imply framebuffer incompleteness.
primaryReferences.use: Explains attribution limits of the r7 aggregate error sample.

isolatedSoftwareProbe.embeddedScript:
"""Isolated EGL/GLES test, not an Expo/iPhone reproduction.
Requires a local libEGL implementation supporting a software ES 3 context.
No application files, device state, or saves are accessed.
"""
import ctypes as C
import json
import os
import sys
os.environ.setdefault('EGL_PLATFORM', 'surfaceless')
os.environ.setdefault('LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE', '1')
E = C.CDLL('libEGL.so.1')
I, U, P = C.c_int, C.c_uint, C.c_void_p

def bind(name, restype, *args):
    f = getattr(E, name)
    f.restype, f.argtypes = restype, list(args)
    return f
get_display = bind('eglGetDisplay', P, P)
initialize = bind('eglInitialize', U, P, C.POINTER(I), C.POINTER(I))
choose = bind('eglChooseConfig', U, P, C.POINTER(I), C.POINTER(P), I, C.POINTER(I))
bind_api = bind('eglBindAPI', U, U)
create_ctx = bind('eglCreateContext', P, P, P, P, C.POINTER(I))
create_surface = bind('eglCreatePbufferSurface', P, P, P, C.POINTER(I))
make_current = bind('eglMakeCurrent', U, P, P, P, P)
get_proc = bind('eglGetProcAddress', P, C.c_char_p)
destroy_ctx = bind('eglDestroyContext', U, P, P)
destroy_surface = bind('eglDestroySurface', U, P, P)
terminate = bind('eglTerminate', U, P)
egl_error = bind('eglGetError', U)

def check(ok, label):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(label + ': EGL=' + hex(egl_error()))

def gl(name, result, *args):
    p = get_proc(name.encode())
    if not p:
        raise RuntimeError('Unavailable function: ' + name)
    return C.CFUNCTYPE(result, *args)(p)

d = get_display(None)
a, b = I(), I()
ctx = surface = None
try:
    check(initialize(d, C.byref(a), C.byref(b)), 'initialize')
    check(bind_api(0x30A0), 'bind ES API')
    attrs = (I * 13)(0x3033, 1, 0x3040, 0x40, 0x3024, 8, 0x3023, 8, 0x3022, 8, 0x3021, 8, 0x3038)
    cfg, n = P(), I()
    check(choose(d, attrs, C.byref(cfg), 1, C.byref(n)) and n.value, 'choose ES3 config')
    ctx = create_ctx(d, cfg, None, (I * 3)(0x3098, 3, 0x3038))
    check(ctx, 'create ES3 context')
    surface = create_surface(d, cfg, (I * 5)(0x3057, 4, 0x3056, 4, 0x3038))
    check(surface, 'create pbuffer')
    check(make_current(d, surface, surface, ctx), 'make current')
    get_error = gl('glGetError', U)
    get_string = gl('glGetString', C.c_char_p, U)
    gen_fb = gl('glGenFramebuffers', None, I, C.POINTER(U))
    bind_fb = gl('glBindFramebuffer', None, U, U)
    gen_tex = gl('glGenTextures', None, I, C.POINTER(U))
    bind_tex = gl('glBindTexture', None, U, U)
    tex_image = gl('glTexImage2D', None, U, I, I, I, I, I, U, U, P)
    tex_param = gl('glTexParameteri', None, U, U, I)
    attach = gl('glFramebufferTexture2D', None, U, U, U, U, I)
    status = gl('glCheckFramebufferStatus', U, U)
    draw_buffers = gl('glDrawBuffers', None, I, C.POINTER(U))
    delete_fb = gl('glDeleteFramebuffers', None, I, C.POINTER(U))
    delete_tex = gl('glDeleteTextures', None, I, C.POINTER(U))
    def errors():
        out = []
        for _ in range(16):
            e = get_error()
            if e == 0:
                return out
            out.append(hex(e))
        raise RuntimeError('Error queue not exhausted within limit')
    init_errors = errors()
    draw_buffers(1, (U * 1)(0x0405))  # BACK on real default framebuffer
    default_errors = errors()
    fb, tex = U(), U()
    gen_fb(1, C.byref(fb)); gen_tex(1, C.byref(tex))
    bind_tex(0x0DE1, tex)
    tex_param(0x0DE1, 0x2801, 0x2600)
    tex_param(0x0DE1, 0x2800, 0x2600)
    tex_image(0x0DE1, 0, 0x8058, 4, 4, 0, 0x1908, 0x1401, None)
    bind_fb(0x8D40, fb)
    attach(0x8D40, 0x8CE0, 0x0DE1, tex, 0)
    complete_before = status(0x8D40)
    setup_errors = errors()
    draw_buffers(1, (U * 1)(0x0405))  # BACK on nonzero native FBO
    invalid_errors = errors()
    complete_after = status(0x8D40)
    status_errors = errors()
    draw_buffers(1, (U * 1)(0x8CE0))  # same FBO with COLOR_ATTACHMENT0
    corrected_errors = errors()
    result = {
        'scope': 'Isolated software EGL/OpenGL ES probe; NOT user application, NOT iPhone',
        'egl': f'{a.value}.{b.value}',
        'glVersion': get_string(0x1F02).decode(),
        'renderer': get_string(0x1F01).decode(),
        'initialErrors': init_errors,
        'realDefaultFramebuffer_BACK_errors': default_errors,
        'nonzeroFramebufferId': fb.value,
        'framebufferStatusBefore': complete_before,
        'setupErrors': setup_errors,
        'nonzeroFramebuffer_BACK_errors': invalid_errors,
        'framebufferStatusAfter': complete_after,
        'statusErrors': status_errors,
        'nonzeroFramebuffer_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0_errors': corrected_errors,
    }
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    bind_fb(0x8D40, 0)
    delete_fb(1, C.byref(fb)); delete_tex(1, C.byref(tex))
    assert not init_errors and not setup_errors and not default_errors
    assert complete_before == complete_after == 36053
    assert invalid_errors == ['0x502'] and not status_errors and not corrected_errors
finally:
    if d:
        make_current(d, None, None, None)
        if surface: destroy_surface(d, surface)
        if ctx: destroy_ctx(d, ctx)
        terminate(d)
limitations: Mesa software GLES validates this GL rule; it does not recreate the actual iOS EAGL drawable or prove a fix on the user device.
No app runtime, saved progress, media, or native presentation was exercised.

nextEvidence: Candidate adapter regression/integration checks are separate. Real iPhone retry must establish a submitted main/reflection frame and successful native presentation with no GL errors before native acceptance can pass.
